verdict.rationale: Grok has a programmatic REST API with an OpenAPI spec, a quickstart that sends coding prompts to Grok Build, and structured JSON outputs, so it can be called non-interactively from scripts or CI. A community comment says Grok Build runs in a terminal, but nothing documents a non-interactive or headless agent mode or a CI integration. missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI mode for Grok Build, CI integration guides (e.g. GitHub Actions), API-key auth guidance for automation, independent hands-on reports of CI use.
